definitionZh: 边框式的 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑内线边框的样式,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边框样式. 它对应边框-顶部风格和边框-底部风格,或边框-左部风格和边框-右部风格的属性,这取决于为写法模式、方向和文字定向定义的值。
sourceDefinition: The border-inline-style CSS property defines the style of the logical inline borders of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style and border-bottom-style, or border-left-style and border-right-style properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
